verdict.rationale: The evidence covers Appwrite's AI tooling for external agents: an MCP server, skills files, docs as Markdown, and Claude Code/Codex plugins. Nothing documents an AI assistant built into the Appwrite Console that writes queries, debugs errors, or explains the backend. Connecting outside assistants through MCP is an adjacent capability, not the in-dashboard assistant this story asks for.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can ask an AI assistant in the dashboard to write queries, debug errors, and explain my backend
